# Vendored: @druxt-contrib/inline-content-edit

Built from `druxt/druxt-inline-content-edit`, `feature/9-tokens-follow-the-backend` at commit `cf2abddd343b`.

Vendored rather than installed because the package is not published yet.
Written by `npm run vendor:sync -- inline-content-edit <checkout> <ref>`: run that again
rather than editing these files, so this record stays true.

Declared as `file:vendor/inline-content-edit` so the package name resolves in
`node_modules`, which a component or plugin template needs when it imports
the package by name.
